translations.idiomatic: He served in Jingnan, entered court as doctor in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was transferred to supervising secretary in the Ministry of War and director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 寶歷中，考制策甚精，轉兵部郎中，知制誥，拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: In the Baoli era he examined policy examinations with great precision, was transferred to Director in the Ministry of War, drafted edicts, and was appointed Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the Baoli era he examined policy examinations with great precision, was transferred to director in the Ministry of War, drafted edicts, and was appointed secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 太和四年，出為華州刺史、兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taihe he was sent out as Governor of Hua Prefecture, concurrently Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taihe (830) he was sent out as governor of Huazhou, concurrently censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 入拜左散騎常侍，兼秘書監。

translations.literal: He entered court as Left Regular Attendant, concurrently Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as left regular attendant, concurrently director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八年，轉尚書右丞。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (834) he was transferred to right vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 九年，為兵部侍郎，尋改吏部。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was Vice Minister of War and soon was changed to Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (835) he was vice minister of war and soon was changed to vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 開成元年四月卒，時年六十五。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Kaicheng he died at the age of sixty-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Kaicheng (836) he died at the age of sixty-five.

sentences.zh: 虞仲簡淡寡欲，立性方雅，奕代文學，達而不矜，士友重之。

translations.literal: Yuzhong was simple and sparing in desire, upright and refined by nature; his family had produced literature for generations; though eminent he was not arrogant, and scholars esteemed him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuzhong was simple and sparing in desire, upright and refined by nature; his family had produced literature for generations; though eminent he was not arrogant, and scholars esteemed him.

sentences.zh: 王質

translations.literal: Wang Zhi
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhi

sentences.zh: 王質，字華卿，太原祁人。

translations.literal: Wang Zhi, style name Huaqing, was a native of Qi in Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhi, whose style name was Huaqing, was from Qi in Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 五代祖通，字仲淹，隋末大儒，號文中子。

translations.literal: His fifth-generation ancestor Tong, style name Zhongyan, was a great Confucian of the late Sui and was called Master Wenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: His fifth-generation ancestor Tong, whose style name was Zhongyan, was a great Confucian of the late Sui and was called Master Wenzhong.

sentences.zh: 通生福祚，終上蔡主簿。

translations.literal: Tong begot Fuzuo, who ended as secretary of Shangcai.
translations.idiomatic: Tong begot Fuzuo, who ended as secretary of Shangcai.

sentences.zh: 福祚生勉，登進士第，制策登科，位終寶鼎令。

translations.literal: Fuzuo begot Mian, who passed the jinshi examination and the policy examination and ended as magistrate of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzuo begot Mian, who passed the jinshi examination and the policy examination and ended as magistrate of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 勉生怡，終渝州司戶。

translations.literal: Mian begot Yi, who ended as Registrar of Yu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mian begot Yi, who ended as registrar of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 怡生潛，揚州天長丞。

translations.literal: Yi begot Qian, aide of Tianchang in Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yi begot Qian, aide of Tianchang in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 質則潛之第五子。

translations.literal: Zhi was Qian's fifth son.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi was Qian's fifth son.

sentences.zh: 少負誌操，以家世官卑，思立名於世，以大其門。

translations.literal: In youth he possessed moral resolve; because his family's offices were low, he wished to establish a name in the world and enlarge his house.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he possessed moral resolve; because his family's offices were low, he wished to establish a name in the world and enlarge his house.

sentences.zh: 寓居壽春，躬耕以養母，專以講學為事，門人受業者大集其門。

translations.literal: He lived in Shouchun, personally farming to support his mother, and devoted himself entirely to lecturing; students receiving his instruction gathered greatly at his gate.
translations.idiomatic: He lived in Shouchun, personally farming to support his mother, and devoted himself entirely to lecturing; students receiving his instruction gathered greatly at his gate.

sentences.zh: 年甫強仕，不求聞達，親友規之曰：「以華卿之才，取名位如俯拾地芥耳，安自苦於亹茸者乎？

translations.literal: When he had just reached the prime of life he did not seek fame; relatives and friends admonished him: "With Huaqing's talent, winning name and rank is like picking up mustard seeds from the ground—why do you afflict yourself among the lowly?
translations.idiomatic: When he had just reached the prime of life he did not seek fame; relatives and friends admonished him: "With Huaqing's talent, winning name and rank is like picking up mustard seeds from the ground—why do you afflict yourself among the lowly?

sentences.zh: 揚名顯親，非耕稼可致也。」

translations.literal: To make a name and honor one's parents is not something farming can achieve."
translations.idiomatic: To make a name and honor one's parents is not something farming can achieve."

sentences.zh: 質乃白於母，請赴鄉舉。

translations.literal: Zhi then informed his mother and requested to go to the local examination.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi then informed his mother and requested to go to the local examination.

sentences.zh: 元和六年，登進士甲科。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanhe he passed the jinshi examination in the first class.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yuanhe (811) he passed the jinshi examination in the first class.

sentences.zh: 釋褐嶺南管記，歷佐淮蔡、許昌、梓潼、興元四府，累奏兼監察御史。

translations.literal: On leaving office he was recorder for Lingnan, served successively in Huai-Si, Xuchang, Zitong, and Xingyuan, and was repeatedly memorialized as Acting Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On leaving office he was recorder for Lingnan, served successively in Huai-Si, Xuchang, Zitong, and Xingyuan, and was repeatedly memorialized as acting censor.

sentences.zh: 入朝為殿中，遷侍御史、戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: He entered court as Attending Censor, was transferred to Attending Censor and Supervising Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as attending censor, was transferred to attending censor and supervising secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 為舊府延薦、檢校司封郎中，賜金紫，充興元節度副使。

translations.literal: His former office recommended him, made him Acting Director in the Ministry of Rites, granted golden seal and purple ribbon, and appointed him deputy military governor of Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His former office recommended him, made him acting director in the Ministry of Rites, granted golden seal and purple ribbon, and appointed him deputy military governor of Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 入為戶部郎中，遷諫議大夫。

translations.literal: He entered court as Director in the Ministry of Revenue and was transferred to Remonstrance Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as director in the Ministry of Revenue and was transferred to remonstrance grandee.

sentences.zh: 太和中，王守澄構陷宰相宋申錫。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era, Wang Shoucheng framed Chief Minister Song Shenxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era, Wang Shoucheng framed Chief Minister Song Shenxi.

sentences.zh: 文宗怒，欲加極法。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong was angry and wished to apply the extreme penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong was angry and wished to apply the extreme penalty.

sentences.zh: 質與常侍崔玄亮雨泣切諫，請付外推，申錫方從輕典。

translations.literal: Zhi, together with Regular Attendant Cui Xuanliang, wept in the rain and remonstrated urgently, requesting that the case be handed to external investigation; only then was Shenxi given a lighter punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi, together with regular attendant Cui Xuanliang, wept in the rain and remonstrated urgently, requesting that the case be handed to external investigation; only then was Shenxi given a lighter punishment.

sentences.zh: 質為中人側目，執政出為虢州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhi drew the hostile gaze of the eunuchs, and the chief ministers sent him out as prefect of Guo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi drew the hostile gaze of the eunuchs, and the chief ministers sent him out as prefect of Guozhou.

sentences.zh: 質射策時，深為李吉甫所器；

translations.literal: At the time of the policy examination he had been deeply valued by Li Jifu;
translations.idiomatic: At the time of the policy examination he had been deeply valued by Li Jifu;

sentences.zh: 及德裕為相，甚禮之，事必咨決。

translations.literal: when Deyu became chief minister he treated him with great courtesy and consulted him on every matter.
translations.idiomatic: when Deyu became chief minister he treated him with great courtesy and consulted him on every matter.

sentences.zh: 尋召為給事中、河南尹。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned as Supervising Secretary and Governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was summoned as supervising secretary and governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 八年，為宣州刺史、兼御史中丞、宣歙團練觀察使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was Governor of Xuan Prefecture, concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief and Xuan-She Defense and Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (834) he was governor of Xuanzhou, concurrently vice censor-in-chief and Xuan-She defense and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 在政三年。

translations.literal: He governed for three years.
translations.idiomatic: He governed for three years.

sentences.zh: 開成元年十二月，無疾暴卒，時年六十八，贈左散騎常侍，謚曰定。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Kaicheng he died suddenly without illness at the age of sixty-eight; he was posthumously appointed Left Regular Attendant and given the posthumous title Ding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Kaicheng (836) he died suddenly without illness at the age of sixty-eight; he was posthumously appointed left regular attendant and given the posthumous title Ding.

sentences.zh: 質清廉方雅，為政有聲。

translations.literal: Zhi was pure, incorrupt, upright, and refined, and his governance had a reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi was pure, incorrupt, upright, and refined, and his governance had a reputation.

sentences.zh: 雖權臣待之厚，而行己有素，不涉朋比之議。

translations.literal: Though powerful ministers treated him generously, his conduct was consistent by nature and he did not become involved in factional talk.
translations.idiomatic: Though powerful ministers treated him generously, his conduct was consistent by nature and he did not become involved in factional talk.

sentences.zh: 在宣城辟崔珦、劉濩、裴夷直、趙丱為從事，皆一代名流。

translations.literal: At Xuancheng he recruited Cui Guang, Liu Huo, Pei Yizhi, and Zhao Guan as staff officers; all were leading figures of the age.
translations.idiomatic: At Xuancheng he recruited Cui Guang, Liu Huo, Pei Yizhi, and Zhao Guan as staff officers; all were leading figures of the age.

sentences.zh: 視其所與，人士重之。

translations.literal: Judging by those he associated with, scholars esteemed him.
translations.idiomatic: Judging by those he associated with, scholars esteemed him.

sentences.zh: 子曰慶存。

translations.literal: His son was Qingcun.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Qingcun.

sentences.zh: 盧簡辭

translations.literal: Lu Jianci
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jianci

sentences.zh: 盧簡辭，字子策，范陽人，後徙家於蒲。

translations.literal: Lu Jianci, style name Zice, was a native of Fanyang; his family later moved to Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jianci, whose style name was Zice, was from Fanyang; his family later moved to Pu.

sentences.zh: 祖翰。

translations.literal: His grandfather was Han.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Han.

sentences.zh: 父綸，天寶末舉進士，遇亂不第，奉親避地於鄱陽，與郡人吉中孚為林泉之友。

translations.literal: His father Lun, at the end of the Tianbao era, passed the jinshi examination; encountering disorder he did not attain office, took his parents to shelter in Poyang, and with the local man Ji Zhongfu became friends in forest and spring.
translations.idiomatic: His father Lun, at the end of the Tianbao era, passed the jinshi examination; encountering disorder he did not attain office, took his parents to shelter in Poyang, and with the local man Ji Zhongfu became friends in forest and spring.

sentences.zh: 大歷初，還京師，宰相王縉奏為集賢學士、秘書省校書郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Dali era he returned to the capital; Chief Minister Wang Ji memorialized him as academician in the Hall of Assembled Talents and collator in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Dali era he returned to the capital; chief minister Wang Ji memorialized him as academician in the Hall of Assembled Talents and collator in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 王縉兄弟有詩名於世，縉既官重，凡所延辟，皆辭人名士，以綸能詩，禮待逾厚。

translations.literal: Wang Ji's brothers had a poetic reputation in the world; since Ji held heavy office, all those he recruited were literary men and famous scholars; because Lun could compose poetry, he was treated with courtesy exceeding the norm.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji's brothers had a poetic reputation in the world; since Ji held heavy office, all those he recruited were literary men and famous scholars; because Lun could compose poetry, he was treated with courtesy exceeding the norm.

sentences.zh: 會縉得罪，坐累。

translations.literal: When Ji was punished, Lun was implicated.
translations.idiomatic: When Ji was punished, Lun was implicated.

sentences.zh: 久之，調陜府戶曹、河南密縣令。

translations.literal: After a long time he was transferred to staff officer in Shaanfu and magistrate of Mi County in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was transferred to staff officer in Shaanfu and magistrate of Mi County in Henan.

sentences.zh: 建中初，為昭應令。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jianzhong era he was magistrate of Zhaoying.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jianzhong era he was magistrate of Zhaoying.

sentences.zh: 硃泚之亂，咸寧王渾瑊充京城西面副元帥，乃拔綸為元帥判官、檢校金部郎中。

translations.literal: In the rebellion of Zhu Ci, the Prince of Xianning Hun Zhen served as deputy supreme commander of the western capital; he then selected Lun as aide to the supreme commander and Acting Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the rebellion of Zhu Ci, the Prince of Xianning Hun Zhen served as deputy supreme commander of the western capital; he then selected Lun as aide to the supreme commander and acting director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 貞元中，吉中孚為翰林學士、戶部侍郎，典邦賦，薦綸於朝。

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan era, Ji Zhongfu was Hanlin academician and Vice Minister of Revenue and controlled state revenue; he recommended Lun to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenyuan era, Ji Zhongfu was Hanlin academician and vice minister of revenue and controlled state revenue; he recommended Lun to court.

sentences.zh: 會丁家艱，而中孚卒。

translations.literal: When he encountered mourning for his family, Zhongfu died.
translations.idiomatic: When he encountered mourning for his family, Zhongfu died.

sentences.zh: 太府卿韋渠牟得幸於德宗，綸即渠牟之甥也，數稱綸之才。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of the Imperial Treasury Wei Qumou gained favor with Dezong; Lun was Qumou's nephew by marriage and repeatedly praised Lun's talent.
translations.idiomatic: Grand minister of the imperial treasury Wei Qumou gained favor with Dezong; Lun was Qumou's nephew by marriage and repeatedly praised Lun's talent.

sentences.zh: 德宗召之內殿，令和禦制詩，超拜戶部郎中。

translations.literal: Dezong summoned him to the inner hall and ordered him to harmonize with imperial poems; he was promoted out of turn to Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong summoned him to the inner hall and ordered him to harmonize with imperial poems; he was promoted out of turn to director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 方欲委之掌誥，居無何，卒。

translations.literal: He was just about to be entrusted with drafting edicts when, before long, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He was just about to be entrusted with drafting edicts when, before long, he died.

sentences.zh: 初，大歷中，詩人李端、錢起、韓翃輩能為五言詩；

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Dali era, the poets Li Duan, Qian Qi, and Han Hong could compose five-character verse;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the Dali era, the poets Li Duan, Qian Qi, and Han Hong could compose five-character verse;

sentences.zh: 而辭情捷麗，綸作尤工。

translations.literal: and in swiftness of expression and beauty of feeling, Lun's compositions were especially skillful.
translations.idiomatic: and in swiftness of expression and beauty of feeling, Lun's compositions were especially skillful.

sentences.zh: 至貞元末，錢、李諸公雕落，綸嘗為《懷舊詩》五十韻，敘其事曰：「吾與吉侍郎中孚、司空郎中曙、苗員外發、崔補闕峒、耿拾遺湋、李校書端，風塵追遊，向三十載。

translations.literal: By the end of the Zhenyuan era, Qian, Li, and the others had passed away; Lun once composed a fifty-rhyme poem of remembrance and narrated the matter, saying: "I and Vice Director Ji Zhongfu, Director Sikong Shu, Supervising Secretary Miao Fa, Remonstrance Supplementer Cui Tong, Remonstrance Supplementer Geng Wei, and Secretary Li Duan pursued one another through wind and dust for nearly thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of the Zhenyuan era, Qian, Li, and the others had passed away; Lun once composed a fifty-rhyme poem of remembrance and narrated the matter, saying: "I and Vice Director Ji Zhongfu, Director Sikong Shu, Supervising Secretary Miao Fa, Remonstrance Supplementer Cui Tong, Remonstrance Supplementer Geng Wei, and Secretary Li Duan pursued one another through wind and dust for nearly thirty years.

sentences.zh: 數公皆負當時盛稱榮耀，未幾，俱沈下泉。

translations.literal: These gentlemen all bore the glory of the age's highest praise; before long, all sank beneath the spring.
translations.idiomatic: These gentlemen all bore the glory of the age's highest praise; before long, all sank beneath the spring.

sentences.zh: 傷悼之際，常暢博士追感前事，賦詩五十韻見寄。

translations.literal: In the moment of grief, Doctor Chang Chang, moved by past events, composed a fifty-rhyme poem and sent it to me.
translations.idiomatic: In the moment of grief, Doctor Chang Chang, moved by past events, composed a fifty-rhyme poem and sent it to me.

sentences.zh: 輒有所酬，以申悲舊，兼寄夏侯審侍御。」

translations.literal: I composed a response to express sorrow for the old days, and also sent it to Attending Censor Xiahou Shen."
translations.idiomatic: I composed a response to express sorrow for the old days, and also sent it to Attending Censor Xiahou Shen."

sentences.zh: 其歷言諸子云：「侍郎文章宗，傑出淮楚靈。

translations.literal: In enumerating the gentlemen he wrote: "The Vice Director, master of letters, outstanding spirit of Huai and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In enumerating the gentlemen he wrote: "The Vice Director, master of letters, outstanding spirit of Huai and Chu.

sentences.zh: 掌賦若吹籟，司言如建瓴。

translations.literal: Composing rhapsodies like blowing a reed pipe, drafting words like raising a jar on a high roof.
translations.idiomatic: Composing rhapsodies like blowing a reed pipe, drafting words like raising a jar on a high roof.

sentences.zh: 郎中善慶余，雅韻與琴清。

translations.literal: The Director, rich in fine blessings, elegant tone harmonizing with the clear qin.
translations.idiomatic: The Director, rich in fine blessings, elegant tone harmonizing with the clear qin.

sentences.zh: 郁郁松帶雪，蕭蕭鴻入冥。

translations.literal: Lush pine bearing snow, lofty swan entering the dark sky.
translations.idiomatic: Lush pine bearing snow, lofty swan entering the dark sky.

sentences.zh: 員外貞貴儒，弱冠被華纓。

translations.literal: The Supervising Secretary, upright and noble Confucian, at a tender age adorned with splendid tassels.
translations.idiomatic: The Supervising Secretary, upright and noble Confucian, at a tender age adorned with splendid tassels.

sentences.zh: 月香飄桂實，乳溜瀝瓊英。

translations.literal: Moon fragrance drifting from cassia fruit, milky droplets dripping from jade blossoms.
translations.idiomatic: Moon fragrance drifting from cassia fruit, milky droplets dripping from jade blossoms.

sentences.zh: 補闕思沖融，巾拂藝亦精。

translations.literal: The Remonstrance Supplementer, thoughts harmonious and blended, kerchief and whisk arts also refined.
translations.idiomatic: The Remonstrance Supplementer, thoughts harmonious and blended, kerchief and whisk arts also refined.

sentences.zh: 彩蝶戲方圃，瑞雲滋翠屏。

translations.literal: Colored butterflies sporting in a square garden, auspicious clouds nourishing emerald screens.
translations.idiomatic: Colored butterflies sporting in a square garden, auspicious clouds nourishing emerald screens.

sentences.zh: 拾遺興難侔，逸調曠無程。

translations.literal: The Remonstrance Supplementer, spirit hard to match, free-ranging tone vast without measure.
translations.idiomatic: The Remonstrance Supplementer, spirit hard to match, free-ranging tone vast without measure.

sentences.zh: 九醖貯彌潔，三花寒轉馨。

translations.literal: Nine brews stored ever purer, three flowers in cold turning fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Nine brews stored ever purer, three flowers in cold turning fragrant.

sentences.zh: 校書才智雄，舉世一娉婷。

translations.literal: The Secretary, talent and wisdom heroic, peerless beauty in all the world.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretary, talent and wisdom heroic, peerless beauty in all the world.

sentences.zh: 賭墅鬼神變，屬辭鸞鳳驚。

translations.literal: Gambling at the villa, spirits transform; composing phrases, phoenixes startle.
translations.idiomatic: Gambling at the villa, spirits transform; composing phrases, phoenixes startle.

sentences.zh: 差肩曳長裾，總轡奉和鈴。

translations.literal: Shoulder to shoulder trailing long robes, reins gathered in harmony with bells.
translations.idiomatic: Shoulder to shoulder trailing long robes, reins gathered in harmony with bells.

sentences.zh: 共賦瑤臺雪，同觀金谷笙。

translations.literal: Together composing on Jade Terrace snow, together viewing music at Golden Valley.
translations.idiomatic: Together composing on Jade Terrace snow, together viewing music at Golden Valley.

sentences.zh: 倚天方比劍，沈水忽如瓶。

translations.literal: Leaning on heaven like comparing swords, sinking in water suddenly like a bottle.
translations.idiomatic: Leaning on heaven like comparing swords, sinking in water suddenly like a bottle.

sentences.zh: 君持玉盤珠，寫我懷袖盈。

translations.literal: You hold jade dish pearls and inscribe what fills my sleeves.
translations.idiomatic: You hold jade dish pearls and inscribe what fills my sleeves.

sentences.zh: 讀罷涕交頤，願言躋百齡。」

translations.literal: When I finish reading, tears cross my cheeks; I wish to say, may you ascend a hundred years."
translations.idiomatic: When I finish reading, tears cross my cheeks; I wish to say, may you ascend a hundred years."

sentences.zh: 綸之才思，皆此類也。

translations.literal: Lun's literary talent was all of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: Lun's literary talent was all of this kind.

sentences.zh: 文宗好文，尤重綸詩，嘗問侍臣曰：「《盧綸集》幾卷？

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong loved literature and especially valued Lun's poetry; he once asked the attending ministers: "How many juan are in the Collected Works of Lu Lun?
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong loved literature and especially valued Lun's poetry; he once asked the attending ministers: "How many juan are in the Collected Works of Lu Lun?

sentences.zh: 有子弟否？」

translations.literal: Does he have sons?"
translations.idiomatic: Does he have sons?"

sentences.zh: 李德裕對曰：「綸有四男，皆登進士第，今員外郎簡能、侍御史簡辭是也。」

translations.literal: Li Deyu answered: "Lun had four sons, all of whom passed the jinshi examination; the present Supervising Secretary Jianneng and Attending Censor Jianci are they."
translations.idiomatic: Li Deyu answered: "Lun had four sons, all of whom passed the jinshi examination; the present supervising secretary Jianneng and attending censor Jianci are they."

sentences.zh: 即遣中使詣其家，令進文集。

translations.literal: He immediately sent a palace envoy to their home and ordered the collected works presented.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately sent a palace envoy to their home and ordered the collected works presented.

sentences.zh: 簡能盡以所集五百篇上獻，優詔嘉之。

translations.literal: Jianneng presented all five hundred pieces he had collected; an edict of praise commended him.
translations.idiomatic: Jianneng presented all five hundred pieces he had collected; an edict of praise commended him.

sentences.zh: 簡辭，元和六年登第，三辟諸侯府。

translations.literal: Jianci passed the examination in the sixth year of Yuanhe and was three times recruited to regional staff offices.
translations.idiomatic: Jianci passed the examination in the sixth year of Yuanhe (811) and was three times recruited to regional staff offices.

sentences.zh: 長慶末，入朝為監察，轉侍御史。

translations.literal: At the end of Changqing he entered court as censor and was transferred to attending censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Changqing he entered court as censor and was transferred to attending censor.

sentences.zh: 文雅之余，尤精法律，歷朝簿籍，靡不經懷。

translations.literal: Beyond literary refinement he was especially skilled in law; records of successive reigns—none escaped his mind.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond literary refinement he was especially skilled in law; records of successive reigns—none escaped his mind.

sentences.zh: 寶歷中，故京兆尹黎幹男煟詣臺治父葉縣舊業，臺司莫知本末。

translations.literal: In the Baoli era, the former Metropolitan Governor Li Gan's son Wei came to the censorate to pursue his father's old estate in Ye County; the censorate did not know the background.
translations.idiomatic: In the Baoli era, the former metropolitan governor Li Gan's son Wei came to the censorate to pursue his father's old estate in Ye County; the censorate did not know the background.

sentences.zh: 簡辭曰：「幹坐魚朝恩黨誅，田產籍沒。

translations.literal: Jianci said: "Gan was executed as a member of Yu Chao'en's faction, and his land was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Jianci said: "Gan was executed as a member of Yu Chao'en's faction, and his land was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 大歷已來，多少赦令，豈有雪朝恩、黎幹節文？

translations.literal: Since the Dali era, how many amnesty edicts have there been—how could there be language restoring Yu Chao'en and Li Gan?
translations.idiomatic: Since the Dali era, how many amnesty edicts have there been—how could there be language restoring Yu Chao'en and Li Gan?

sentences.zh: 況其田產分給百姓，將及百年，而煟恃中助而冒論耶！」

translations.literal: Moreover, his land was distributed to the common people and has been nearly a hundred years—yet Wei relies on palace support to press a claim!"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, his land was distributed to the common people and has been nearly a hundred years—yet Wei relies on palace support to press a claim!"

sentences.zh: 乃移汝州刺史裴通，準大歷元年敕給百姓。

translations.literal: He then sent orders to Prefect Pei Tong of Ru Prefecture to distribute it to the common people according to the edict of the first year of Dali.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent orders to Prefect Pei Tong of Ruzhou to distribute it to the common people according to the edict of the first year of Dali.

sentences.zh: 又福建鹽鐵院官盧昂坐贓三十萬，簡辭按之，於其家得金床、瑟瑟枕大如鬥。

translations.literal: Also, Lu Ang, official of the Fujian Salt and Iron Commission, was convicted of corruption totaling three hundred thousand; Jianci investigated him and at his home found a golden bed and a sese pillow as large as a peck-measure.
translations.idiomatic: Also, Lu Ang, official of the Fujian Salt and Iron Commission, was convicted of corruption totaling three hundred thousand; Jianci investigated him and at his home found a golden bed and a sese pillow as large as a peck-measure.

sentences.zh: 昭湣見之曰：「此宮中所無，而盧昂為吏可知也！」

translations.literal: When Zhaomin saw them he said: "These are not in the palace—yet from Lu Ang as an official one can tell!"
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaomin saw them he said: "These are not in the palace—yet from Lu Ang as an official one can tell!"

sentences.zh: 尋轉考功員外郎，轉郎中。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Supervising Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel and then to Director.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to supervising secretary in the Ministry of Personnel and then to director.

sentences.zh: 太和中，坐事自太仆卿出為衢州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era, for an offense he was sent out from Minister of the Imperial Stud to be prefect of Qu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era, for an offense he was sent out from minister of the imperial stud to be prefect of Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，入為刑部侍郎，轉戶部。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era he entered court as Vice Minister of Justice and was transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era he entered court as vice minister of justice and was transferred to vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 大中初，轉兵部侍郎、檢校工部尚書、許州刺史、御史大夫、忠武軍節度使，遷檢校刑部尚書、襄州刺史、山南東道節度使，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he was transferred to Vice Minister of War, Acting Minister of Works, Prefect of Xu Prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, and military governor of Zhongwu Army; he was transferred to Acting Minister of Justice, Prefect of Xiang Prefecture, and military governor of Shannan East Circuit, and died.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he was transferred to vice minister of war, acting minister of works, prefect of Xuzhou, censor-in-chief, and military governor of Zhongwu Army; he was transferred to acting minister of justice, prefect of Xiangzhou, and military governor of Shannan East Circuit, and died.

sentences.zh: 簡辭兄簡能。

translations.literal: Jianci's elder brother Jianneng.
translations.idiomatic: Jianci's elder brother Jianneng.

sentences.zh: 簡能，字子拙，登第後再辟籓府，入為監察御史。

translations.literal: Jianneng, style name Zizhuo, after passing the examination was twice recruited to frontier staff offices and entered court as censor.
translations.idiomatic: Jianneng, whose style name was Zizhuo, after passing the examination was twice recruited to frontier staff offices and entered court as censor.

sentences.zh: 太和九年，由駕部員外檢校司封郎中，充鳳翔節度判官。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Taihe, from Supervising Secretary in the Ministry of War he was made Acting Director in the Ministry of Rites and served as aide to the Fengxiang military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Taihe (835), from supervising secretary in the Ministry of War he was made acting director in the Ministry of Rites and served as aide to the Fengxiang military governor.

sentences.zh: 時鄭註得幸，李訓與之謀誅宦官，俾註鎮鳳翔，仍妙選當時才俊以為賓佐。

translations.literal: At the time Zheng Zhu had gained favor; Li Xun plotted with him to execute the eunuchs, sent Zhu to govern Fengxiang, and still brilliantly selected the talents of the age as aides.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zheng Zhu had gained favor; Li Xun plotted with him to execute the eunuchs, sent Zhu to govern Fengxiang, and still brilliantly selected the talents of the age as aides.

sentences.zh: 簡能與蕭俛弟傑、錢起子可復，皆為訓所選，從註。

translations.literal: Jianneng, together with Xiao Mian's younger brother Jie and Qian Qi's son Kefu, were all chosen by Xun and followed Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Jianneng, together with Xiao Mian's younger brother Jie and Qian Qi's son Kefu, were all chosen by Xun and followed Zhu.

sentences.zh: 及訓敗，註誅。

translations.literal: When Xun failed, Zhu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: When Xun failed, Zhu was executed.

sentences.zh: 簡能、蕭傑等四人皆為監軍使所害。

translations.literal: Jianneng, Xiao Jie, and four others were all killed by the supervisory commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Jianneng, Xiao Jie, and four others were all killed by the supervisory commissioners.

sentences.zh: 簡辭弟弘正、簡求。

translations.literal: Jianci's younger brothers Hongzheng and Jianqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Jianci's younger brothers Hongzheng and Jianqiu.

sentences.zh: 弘正，字子強，元和末登進士第，累辟使府掌書記。

translations.literal: Hongzheng, style name Ziqiang, at the end of the Yuanhe era passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly recruited to regional staff offices as chief secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzheng, whose style name was Ziqiang, at the end of the Yuanhe era passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly recruited to regional staff offices as chief secretary.

sentences.zh: 入朝為監察御史、侍御史。

translations.literal: He entered court as censor and attending censor.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as censor and attending censor.

sentences.zh: 太和中，華州刺史宇文鼎、戶部員外盧允中坐贓，弘正按之。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era, Governor of Hua Prefecture Yuwen Ding and Supervising Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue Lu Yunzhong were convicted of corruption; Hongzheng investigated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era, governor of Huazhou Yuwen Ding and supervising secretary in the Ministry of Revenue Lu Yunzhong were convicted of corruption; Hongzheng investigated them.

sentences.zh: 文宗怒，將殺鼎，弘正奏曰：「鼎歷持綱憲，繩糾之官，今為近輔刺史，以贓汙聞，死固常典。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong was angry and was about to execute Ding; Hongzheng memorialized: "Ding long upheld the standards of law as an official who binds and corrects; now as a nearby assisting prefect he is known for corruption—death is indeed the regular penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong was angry and was about to execute Ding; Hongzheng memorialized: "Ding long upheld the standards of law as an official who binds and corrects; now as a nearby assisting prefect he is known for corruption—death is indeed the regular penalty.

sentences.zh: 但取受之首，罪在允中，監司之責，鼎當連坐。」

translations.literal: But the chief taker of bribes, the crime lies with Yunzhong; the supervisory responsibility, Ding should share in punishment."
translations.idiomatic: But the chief taker of bribes, the crime lies with Yunzhong; the supervisory responsibility, Ding should share in punishment."

sentences.zh: 文宗釋之，鼎方減等。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong released him, and Ding's punishment was reduced by one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong released him, and Ding's punishment was reduced by one degree.

sentences.zh: 三遷兵部郎中、給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted three times to Director in the Ministry of War and Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted three times to director in the Ministry of War and supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 會昌末，王師討劉稹。

translations.literal: At the end of Huichang the imperial army campaigned against Liu Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Huichang the imperial army campaigned against Liu Zhen.

sentences.zh: 時詔河北三帥收山東州郡。

translations.literal: At the time an edict ordered the three military governors of Hebei to recover the prefectures east of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: At the time an edict ordered the three military governors of Hebei to recover the prefectures east of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 俄而何弘敬、王元逵得邢、洺、磁三郡。

translations.literal: Soon He Hongjing and Wang Yuankui obtained the three prefectures of Xing, Ming, and Ci.
translations.idiomatic: Soon He Hongjing and Wang Yuankui obtained the three prefectures of Xing, Ming, and Ci.

sentences.zh: 宰臣奏議曰：「山東三郡，以賊稹未誅，宜且立留後。

translations.literal: The chief ministers memorialized: "The three prefectures east of the mountains—because the rebel Zhen has not yet been executed, it is fitting for the moment to establish acting commanders.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers memorialized: "The three prefectures east of the mountains—because the rebel Zhen has not yet been executed, it is fitting for the moment to establish acting commanders.

sentences.zh: 如弘敬、元逵有所陳請，則朝廷難以依違。」

translations.literal: If Hongjing and Yuankui make requests, the court will find it hard to grant or refuse."
translations.idiomatic: If Hongjing and Yuankui make requests, the court will find it hard to grant or refuse."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「然，誰可任者？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "So—who can be entrusted?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "So—who can be entrusted?"

sentences.zh: 李德裕曰：「給事中盧弘正嘗為昭義判官，性又通敏，推擇攸宜。」

translations.literal: Li Deyu said: "Supervising Secretary Lu Hongzheng once served as aide in Zhaoyi; his nature is also penetrating and quick—the choice is fitting."
translations.idiomatic: Li Deyu said: "Supervising Secretary Lu Hongzheng once served as aide in Zhaoyi; his nature is also penetrating and quick—the choice is fitting."

sentences.zh: 即命為邢洺磁團練觀察留後。

translations.literal: He was immediately appointed Acting Defense and Observation Commissioner of Xing, Ming, and Ci.
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately appointed acting defense and observation commissioner of Xing, Ming, and Ci.

sentences.zh: 未行而稹誅，乃令弘正銜命宣諭河北三鎮。

translations.literal: Before he set out Zhen was executed; he was then ordered to carry the imperial command to proclaim reassurance to the three Hebei commands.
translations.idiomatic: Before he set out Zhen was executed; he was then ordered to carry the imperial command to proclaim reassurance to the three Hebei commands.

sentences.zh: 使還，拜工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On returning from his mission he was appointed Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from his mission he was appointed vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 大中初，轉戶部侍郎，充鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he was transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue and served as salt and iron transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he was transferred to vice minister of revenue and served as salt and iron transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 前是，安邑、解縣兩池鹽法積弊，課入不充。

translations.literal: Before this, the salt laws of the Anyi and Jie County pools had long-standing abuses, and revenue did not meet quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, the salt laws of the Anyi and Jie County pools had long-standing abuses, and revenue did not meet quotas.

sentences.zh: 弘正令判官司空輿至池務檢察，特立新法，仍奏輿為兩池使。

translations.literal: Hongzheng ordered his aide Sikong Yu to go to the pools to inspect affairs, established a new law on the spot, and also memorialized Yu as commissioner of the two pools.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzheng ordered his aide Sikong Yu to go to the pools to inspect affairs, established a new law on the spot, and also memorialized Yu as commissioner of the two pools.

sentences.zh: 三年，課入加倍，其法至今賴之。

translations.literal: In the third year revenue doubled; the law is relied upon to this day.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year revenue doubled; the law is relied upon to this day.

sentences.zh: 檢校戶部尚書，出為徐州刺史、武寧軍節度使、徐泗濠觀察等使。

translations.literal: He was made Acting Minister of Revenue and sent out as Prefect of Xu Prefecture, military governor of Wuning Army, and Xu-Si-Hao Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was made acting minister of revenue and sent out as prefect of Xuzhou, military governor of Wuning Army, and Xu-Si-Hao observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 徐方自智興之後，軍士驕怠，有銀刀都，尤勞姑息，前後屢逐主帥。

translations.literal: Since Zhi Xing, the troops of Xu had been arrogant and lax; there was especially the Silver Blade Corps, most indulged and placated; before and after they repeatedly drove out commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Since Zhi Xing, the troops of Xu had been arrogant and lax; there was especially the Silver Blade Corps, most indulged and placated; before and after they repeatedly drove out commanders.

sentences.zh: 弘正在鎮期年，皆去其首惡，喻之忠義。

translations.literal: During Hongzheng's year in command he removed all the chief evildoers and instructed them in loyalty and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongzheng's year in command he removed all the chief evildoers and instructed them in loyalty and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 訖於受代，軍旋無譁。

translations.literal: By the time he was replaced, the army departed without uproar.
translations.idiomatic: By the time he was replaced, the army departed without uproar.

sentences.zh: 鎮徐四年，遷檢校兵部尚書、汴州刺史、宣武軍節度、宋亳潁觀察等使，卒於鎮。

translations.literal: After governing Xu for four years he was transferred to Acting Minister of War, Prefect of Bian Prefecture, military governor of Xuanwu Army and Song-Bo-Ying Observation Commissioner, and died in his command.
translations.idiomatic: After governing Xu for four years he was transferred to acting minister of war, prefect of Bianzhou, military governor of Xuanwu Army and Song-Bo-Ying observation commissioner, and died in his command.

sentences.zh: 簡求，字子臧，長慶元年登進士第，釋褐江西王仲舒從事。

translations.literal: Jianqiu, style name Zizang, in the first year of Changqing passed the jinshi examination and on leaving office became staff officer to Wang Zhongshu of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Jianqiu, whose style name was Zizang, in the first year of Changqing (821) passed the jinshi examination and on leaving office became staff officer to Wang Zhongshu of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 又從元稹為浙東、江夏二府掌書記。

translations.literal: He also followed Yuan Zhen as chief secretary in Zhedong and Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: He also followed Yuan Zhen as chief secretary in Zhedong and Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 裴度鎮襄陽，保厘洛都，皆辟為賓佐，奏殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: When Pei Du governed Xiangyang and guarded Luoyang, he recruited Jianqiu as aide and memorialized him as Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Pei Du governed Xiangyang and guarded Luoyang, he recruited Jianqiu as aide and memorialized him as attending censor.

sentences.zh: 入朝，拜監察。

translations.literal: He entered court and was appointed censor.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court and was appointed censor.

sentences.zh: 裴度鎮太原，復奏為記室。

translations.literal: When Pei Du governed Taiyuan, he again memorialized him as recorder.
translations.idiomatic: When Pei Du governed Taiyuan, he again memorialized him as recorder.

sentences.zh: 入為殿中，賜緋。

translations.literal: He entered court as Attending Censor and was granted the crimson robe.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as attending censor and was granted the crimson robe.

sentences.zh: 牛僧孺鎮襄漢，辟為觀察判官。

translations.literal: When Niu Sengru governed Xiang and Han, he recruited him as observation aide.
translations.idiomatic: When Niu Sengru governed Xiang and Han, he recruited him as observation aide.

sentences.zh: 入為水部、戶部二員外郎。

translations.literal: He entered court as Supervising Secretary in the Ministries of Waterways and Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as supervising secretary in the ministries of waterways and revenue.

sentences.zh: 會昌末，討劉稹，詔以許帥李彥佐為招討使。

translations.literal: At the end of Huichang, campaigning against Liu Zhen, an edict appointed Military Governor of Xu Li Yanzhuo campaign commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Huichang, campaigning against Liu Zhen, an edict appointed military governor of Xu Li Yanzhuo campaign commander.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以簡求累佐使府，達於機略，乃以簡求為忠武節度副使知節度事、本道供軍使。

translations.literal: The court, because Jianqiu had long served in regional staff offices and understood strategy, appointed Jianqiu deputy military governor of Zhongwu with control of military affairs and supply commissioner of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The court, because Jianqiu had long served in regional staff offices and understood strategy, appointed Jianqiu deputy military governor of Zhongwu with control of military affairs and supply commissioner of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 入為吏部員外，轉本司郎中，求為蘇州刺史。

translations.literal: He entered court as Supervising Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel, was transferred to Director in the same ministry, and requested to be Prefect of Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as supervising secretary in the Ministry of Personnel, was transferred to director in the same ministry, and requested to be prefect of Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 時簡辭鎮漢南，弘正為侍郎，領使務，昆仲皆居顯列，時人榮之。

translations.literal: At the time Jianci governed Hannan, Hongzheng was vice minister and controlled transport affairs; the brothers all held eminent posts, and people of the time took it as an honor.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Jianci governed Hannan, Hongzheng was vice minister and controlled transport affairs; the brothers all held eminent posts, and people of the time took it as an honor.

sentences.zh: 既而宰執不協，弘正出鎮，罷簡求為左庶子分司。

translations.literal: Soon the chief ministers were at odds; Hongzheng went out to govern a command, and Jianqiu was removed as Junior Mentor with duties at the branch office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the chief ministers were at odds; Hongzheng went out to govern a command, and Jianqiu was removed as junior mentor with duties at the branch office.

sentences.zh: 數年，出為壽州刺史。

translations.literal: After several years he was sent out as prefect of Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After several years he was sent out as prefect of Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，党項叛，以簡求為四鎮北庭行軍、涇州刺史、涇原渭武節度押蕃落等使、檢校左散騎常侍、上柱國、范陽縣男、食邑三百戶。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when the Tangut tribes rebelled, Jianqiu was appointed commander of the Four Commands Northern Campaign, Prefect of Jing Prefecture, military governor of Jing-Yuan-Wei-Wu with control of barbarian tribes, Acting Left Regular Attendant, Pillar of State, Baron of Fanyang County with an estate of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (868), when the Tangut tribes rebelled, Jianqiu was appointed commander of the Four Commands Northern Campaign, prefect of Jingzhou, military governor of Jing-Yuan-Wei-Wu with control of barbarian tribes, acting left regular attendant, pillar of state, baron of Fanyang County with an estate of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遷檢校工部尚書、定州刺史、御史大夫、義武軍節度、北平軍等使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Acting Minister of Works, Prefect of Ding Prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, military governor of Yiwu Army and Beiping Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (870) he was transferred to acting minister of works, prefect of Dingzhou, censor-in-chief, military governor of Yiwu Army and Beiping Army.

sentences.zh: 十三年，檢校刑部尚書、鳳翔尹、鳳翔隴西節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was made Acting Minister of Justice, Governor of Fengxiang, and military governor of Fengxiang and Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (872) he was made acting minister of justice, governor of Fengxiang, and military governor of Fengxiang and Longxi.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月，代裴休為太原尹、北都留守，充河東節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year he replaced Pei Xiu as Governor of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Guardian, and Hedong military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year (873) he replaced Pei Xiu as governor of Taiyuan, northern capital guardian, and Hedong military governor.

sentences.zh: 簡求辭翰縱橫，長於應變，所歷四鎮，皆控邊陲。

translations.literal: Jianqiu's literary hand was bold and free; he excelled in adapting to change; in the four commands he served, all controlled the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Jianqiu's literary hand was bold and free; he excelled in adapting to change; in the four commands he served, all controlled the frontier.

sentences.zh: 屬雜虜寇邊，因之移授，所至撫禦，邊鄙晏然。

translations.literal: When mixed barbarians raided the border he was transferred accordingly; wherever he arrived he pacified and controlled, and the frontier remained tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: When mixed barbarians raided the border he was transferred accordingly; wherever he arrived he pacified and controlled, and the frontier remained tranquil.

sentences.zh: 太原軍素管退渾、契苾、沙陁三部落，或撫納不至，多為邊患。

translations.literal: The Taiyuan army had long administered the Tuihun, Qibi, and Shatuo tribes; sometimes in pacifying and accepting them they did not arrive, and they often became border troubles.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiyuan army had long administered the Tuihun, Qibi, and Shatuo tribes; sometimes in pacifying and accepting them they did not arrive, and they often became border troubles.

sentences.zh: 前政或要之詛盟，質之子弟，然為盜不息。

translations.literal: Previous administrators sometimes required oath alliances and held their sons as hostages, yet banditry did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Previous administrators sometimes required oath alliances and held their sons as hostages, yet banditry did not cease.

sentences.zh: 簡求開懷撫待，接以恩信，所質子弟，一切遣之。

translations.literal: Jianqiu received them with open heart, treated them with favor and trust, and sent back all the hostaged sons.
translations.idiomatic: Jianqiu received them with open heart, treated them with favor and trust, and sent back all the hostaged sons.

sentences.zh: 故五部之人，欣然聽命。

translations.literal: Therefore the people of the five tribes gladly obeyed orders.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the people of the five tribes gladly obeyed orders.

sentences.zh: 咸通初，以疾辭，表章瀝懇。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xiantong, because of illness he resigned; his memorials were earnest and repeated.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiantong (860), because of illness he resigned; his memorials were earnest and repeated.

sentences.zh: 制以太子太師致仕，還於東都。

translations.literal: An edict allowed him to retire as Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent and return to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed him to retire as grand mentor to the heir apparent and return to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 都城有園林別墅，歲時行樂，子弟侍側，公卿在席，詩酒賞詠，竟日忘歸，如是者累年。

translations.literal: In the capital he had gardens and villas; each year he went out for pleasure; sons and younger kinsmen attended at his side, dukes and ministers sat at the feast; poetry, wine, appreciation, and song lasted the whole day without return—thus for many years.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital he had gardens and villas; each year he went out for pleasure; sons and younger kinsmen attended at his side, dukes and ministers sat at the feast; poetry, wine, appreciation, and song lasted the whole day without return—thus for many years.

sentences.zh: 五年十月卒，時年七十六。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year he died at the age of seventy-six.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year (864) he died at the age of seventy-six.

sentences.zh: 贈尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: He was posthumously appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 簡能子知猷。

translations.literal: Jianneng's son Zhiyou.
translations.idiomatic: Jianneng's son Zhiyou.

sentences.zh: 知猷登進士第，釋褐秘書省正字。

translations.literal: Zhiyou passed the jinshi examination and on leaving office was proofreader in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyou passed the jinshi examination and on leaving office was proofreader in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 宰臣蕭鄴鎮江陵、成都，辟為兩府記室。

translations.literal: When Chief Minister Xiao Ye governed Jiangling and Chengdu, he recruited him as chief secretary of both offices.
translations.idiomatic: When chief minister Xiao Ye governed Jiangling and Chengdu, he recruited him as chief secretary of both offices.

sentences.zh: 入拜左拾遺，改右補闕、史館修撰，轉員外郎。

translations.literal: He entered court as Left Remonstrance Supplementer, was changed to Right Remonstrance Supplementer and compiler in the Historiography Office, and was transferred to Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as left remonstrance supplementer, was changed to right remonstrance supplementer and compiler in the Historiography Office, and was transferred to supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 出為饒州刺史。

translations.literal: He was sent out as prefect of Rao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as prefect of Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 入拜兵部郎中，賜緋魚，改吏部郎中、太常少卿。

translations.literal: He entered court as Director in the Ministry of War, was granted the crimson fish bag, and was changed to Director in the Ministry of Personnel and Junior Vice Minister of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as director in the Ministry of War, was granted the crimson fish bag, and was changed to director in the Ministry of Personnel and junior vice minister of imperial sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 出為商州刺史。

translations.literal: He was sent out as prefect of Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as prefect of Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 征拜給事中，轉中書舍人。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Supervising Secretary and transferred to Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned and appointed supervising secretary and transferred to secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 僖宗幸山南，襄王偽署，乃避地金州。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xizong went to Shannan, the Prince of Xiang held a false appointment; he then fled to Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xizong went to Shannan, the Prince of Xiang held a false appointment; he then fled to Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 駕還，征拜工部侍郎，轉戶部，判史館，遷尚書右丞、兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned he was summoned as Vice Minister of Works, transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue, controlled the Historiography Office, was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage returned he was summoned as vice minister of works, transferred to vice minister of revenue, controlled the Historiography Office, was transferred to right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 歷太常卿，工部、戶部尚書，復領太常卿。

translations.literal: He served as Minister of Imperial Sacrifices, Minister of Works, and Minister of Revenue, and again headed the Ministry of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He served as minister of imperial sacrifices, minister of works, and minister of revenue, and again headed the Ministry of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 昭宗在華下，加檢校右僕射，守太子少師。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhaozong was at Hua, he was given the additional title of Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Junior Mentor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhaozong was at Hua, he was given the additional title of acting right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and junior mentor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 進位太子太師，檢校司空，卒於華下。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent and Acting Minister of Works, and died at Hua.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to grand mentor to the heir apparent and acting minister of works, and died at Hua.

sentences.zh: 知猷器度長厚，文辭美麗。

translations.literal: Zhiyou's bearing was generous and steady, and his literary style was beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyou's bearing was generous and steady, and his literary style was beautiful.

sentences.zh: 尤工書，落簡措翰，人爭模仿。

translations.literal: He was especially skilled in calligraphy; when he set brush to paper people competed to imitate him.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially skilled in calligraphy; when he set brush to paper people competed to imitate him.

sentences.zh: 子文度，位亦至丞郎。

translations.literal: His son Wendu also rose to director-level office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wendu also rose to director-level office.

sentences.zh: 簡辭無子，以簡求子貽殷、玄禧入繼。

translations.literal: Jianci had no sons; he took Jianqiu's sons Yiyin and Xuanxi to succeed him.
translations.idiomatic: Jianci had no sons; he took Jianqiu's sons Yiyin and Xuanxi to succeed him.

sentences.zh: 貽殷終光祿少卿。

translations.literal: Yiyin ended as Junior Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyin ended as junior vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 玄禧登進士第，終國子博士。

translations.literal: Xuanxi passed the jinshi examination and ended as Doctor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanxi passed the jinshi examination and ended as doctor of the imperial university.

sentences.zh: 弘正子虔灌，有俊才，進士登第。

translations.literal: Hongzheng's son Qian'guan had outstanding talent and passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzheng's son Qian'guan had outstanding talent and passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 所著文筆，為時所稱。

translations.literal: The writings he composed were praised by the age.
translations.idiomatic: The writings he composed were praised by the age.

sentences.zh: 位終秘書監。

translations.literal: He ended as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He ended as director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 簡求十子，而嗣業、汝弼最知名。

translations.literal: Jianqiu had ten sons; Siye and Rubi were most renowned.
translations.idiomatic: Jianqiu had ten sons; Siye and Rubi were most renowned.

sentences.zh: 嗣業進士登第，累辟使府。

translations.literal: Siye passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly recruited to regional staff offices.
translations.idiomatic: Siye passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly recruited to regional staff offices.

sentences.zh: 廣明初，以長安尉直昭文館、左拾遺、右補闕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangming he was captain of Chang'an, served directly in the Zhaowen Hall, and was Left Remonstrance Supplementer and Right Remonstrance Supplementer.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Guangming (880) he was captain of Chang'an, served directly in the Zhaowen Hall, and was left remonstrance supplementer and right remonstrance supplementer.

sentences.zh: 王鐸征兵收兩京，辟為都統判官、檢校禮部郎中，卒。

translations.literal: When Wang Duo raised troops to recover the two capitals, he recruited him as aide to the supreme commander and Acting Director in the Ministry of Rites, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Duo raised troops to recover the two capitals, he recruited him as aide to the supreme commander and acting director in the Ministry of Rites, and he died.

sentences.zh: 汝弼登進士第，累遷至祠部員外郎、知制誥，從昭宗遷洛。

translations.literal: Rubi passed the jinshi examination, rose successively to Supervising Secretary in the Ministry of Rites and drafter of edicts, and followed Emperor Zhaozong in moving the capital to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Rubi passed the jinshi examination, rose successively to supervising secretary in the Ministry of Rites and drafter of edicts, and followed Emperor Zhaozong in moving the capital to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 屬柳璨黨附賊臣，誣陷士族，汝弼懼，移疾退居，客遊上黨。

translations.literal: When Liu Can attached himself to the rebel ministers and falsely accused the gentry clans, Rubi was afraid, took leave for illness and retired, and traveled as a guest in Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Can attached himself to the rebel ministers and falsely accused the gentry clans, Rubi was afraid, took leave for illness and retired, and traveled as a guest in Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 遇潞府為太原所攻，節度使丁會歸降，從會至太原，李克用奏為節度副使，累奏戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: When the Lu prefecture was attacked by Taiyuan, Military Governor Ding Hui surrendered; he followed Hui to Taiyuan, and Li Keyong memorialized him as deputy military governor and repeatedly memorialized him as Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When the Lu prefecture was attacked by Taiyuan, military governor Ding Hui surrendered; he followed Hui to Taiyuan, and Li Keyong memorialized him as deputy military governor and repeatedly memorialized him as vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 太原使府有龍泉亭，簡求節制時手書詩一章，在亭之西壁。

translations.literal: In the Taiyuan staff office there was Longquan Pavilion; when Jianqiu was in command he personally wrote a poem of one section on the west wall of the pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taiyuan staff office there was Longquan Pavilion; when Jianqiu was in command he personally wrote a poem of one section on the west wall of the pavilion.

sentences.zh: 汝弼復為亞帥，每亭中宴集，未嘗居賓位，西向俯首而已，人士嘉之。

translations.literal: When Rubi again became deputy commander, whenever he feasted in the pavilion he never took the guest seat but only faced west and bowed his head; scholars praised him.
translations.idiomatic: When Rubi again became deputy commander, whenever he feasted in the pavilion he never took the guest seat but only faced west and bowed his head; scholars praised him.

sentences.zh: 盧氏兩世貴盛，六卿方鎮相繼，而未有居輔相者。

translations.literal: The Lu clan was noble and prosperous for two generations; ministers and frontier governors followed one another, yet none had yet reached chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: The Lu clan was noble and prosperous for two generations; ministers and frontier governors followed one another, yet none had yet reached chief minister.

sentences.zh: 至中興，嗣業子文紀，仕至尚書中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: In the restoration, Siye's son Wenji rose to Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Chief Minister of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the restoration, Siye's son Wenji rose to vice director of the Secretariat and associate chief minister of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰

translations.literal: The historian says
translations.idiomatic: The historian says

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：孟襄陽之清節，胡廣州之堅正，卒以結權幸而敗，積貨賄而亡。

translations.literal: The historian says: Meng of Xiangyang's pure integrity and Hu of Guangzhou's firm uprightness—in the end they failed through currying favor with the powerful and perished through amassed bribes.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: Meng of Xiangyang's pure integrity and Hu of Guangzhou's firm uprightness—in the end they failed through currying favor with the powerful and perished through amassed bribes.

sentences.zh: 人如面焉，固難知也。

translations.literal: A man's face—how hard it is to know!
translations.idiomatic: A man's face—how hard it is to know!

sentences.zh: 二崔以綱憲相傾，元穎以獻奇取媚，雖遭時多僻，位至鼎司。

translations.literal: The two Cuis overthrew one another through censorial law; Yuanping won favor by presenting curiosities; though they met eccentric times, they reached the rank of chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: The two Cuis overthrew one another through censorial law; Yuanping won favor by presenting curiosities; though they met eccentric times, they reached the rank of chief minister.

sentences.zh: 言之正人，亦孔之醜，而父事宦者，何所逃譏？

translations.literal: To speak of them as upright men is also among the uglinesses of the Master—yet treating a eunuch as a father, how can they escape ridicule?
translations.idiomatic: To speak of them as upright men is also among the uglinesses of the Master—yet treating a eunuch as a father, how can they escape ridicule?

sentences.zh: 以端、綸之才，任不逾元士，而盧簡辭之昆仲，雲摶水擊，郁為鼎門，非德積慶鐘，安能及此？

translations.literal: With the talents of Duan and Lun, their offices did not exceed elementary scholars; yet the brothers of Lu Jianci rose like clouds striking water and flourished as a great house—is this not accumulated virtue and heaped blessing, that they could reach this?
translations.idiomatic: With the talents of Duan and Lun, their offices did not exceed elementary scholars; yet the brothers of Lu Jianci rose like clouds striking water and flourished as a great house—is this not accumulated virtue and heaped blessing, that they could reach this?

sentences.zh: 辭人之後，不亦休哉！

translations.literal: The descendants of men of letters—how splendid!
translations.idiomatic: The descendants of men of letters—how splendid!

sentences.zh: 贊曰：君子喻義，小人近利。

translations.literal: The encomium says: The gentleman understands righteousness; the petty man clings to profit.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: The gentleman understands righteousness; the petty man clings to profit.

sentences.zh: 孟譴胡亡，家財掃地。

translations.literal: When Meng was censured and Hu died, family wealth was swept clean.
translations.idiomatic: When Meng was censured and Hu died, family wealth was swept clean.

sentences.zh: 聲勢相傾，崔、杜醜名。

translations.literal: Power and momentum overthrew one another; the Cuis and Du earned ugly names.
translations.idiomatic: Power and momentum overthrew one another; the Cuis and Du earned ugly names.

sentences.zh: 端、綸諸子，奕葉光榮。

translations.literal: The sons of Duan and Lun—generation after generation, glory.
translations.idiomatic: The sons of Duan and Lun—generation after generation, glory.
